title: City and countryside
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 39 (Pupil PDF worksheet: city and countryside)
intro: Lesson 39: City and countryside: what each is like. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Contrast
points: فِي المَدِينَةِ ضَجِيجٌ لٰكِنْ فِيهَا خِدْمَاتٌ

arabic.text:
أَسْكُنُ فِي مَدِينَةِ بِرْمِنْغْهَام. هِيَ مَدِينَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ فِيهَا مَسَاجِدُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمَكْتَبَاتٌ.
لٰكِنَّ جَدِّي يَسْكُنُ فِي قَرْيَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ فِي الرِّيفِ. هُنَاكَ الهَوَاءُ نَقِيٌّ وَالحَيَاةُ هَادِئَةٌ،
بَيْنَمَا فِي مَدِينَتِي ضَجِيجٌ وَزِحَامٌ.

questions.q: Contrast the city and the countryside in one sentence using بَيْنَمَا.
questions.a: e.g. فِي المَدِينَةِ ضَجِيجٌ بَيْنَمَا الرِّيفُ هَادِئٌ.

questions.q: Write 60 words in the portal response box: describe your area and contrast it with the countryside (or a city), using بَيْنَمَا، لٰكِنْ and one comparative.
questions.a: Accurate description with contrast structures and a comparative

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer

questions.q: What is the countryside like in the text?
options: Clean air and a calm life
questions.a: A) Clean air and a calm life. الهَوَاءُ نَقِيٌّ وَالحَيَاةُ هَادِئَةٌ.
